name: Local Restaurant Discovery API
description: Discover and rank restaurants by location, intent, dietary need, occasion, budget, and quality. /match-restaurant-to-intent returns ranked_restaurants with match_score, cuisine_match, distance, price_level, review_summary, dietary_fit, and best_for in one call. Cheap, high-volume discovery-tier pricing for assistant and concierge agents.

pricing_model.free_tier: GET / discovery is free; new keys include $5 trial credit.

useCases: Find the best romantic, gluten-free-friendly Italian spot within 5 miles under $45/person.
Rank a set of candidate restaurants by a custom weighting of rating, price, and distance.
Compare three restaurants head-to-head before booking.
Power an assistant that recommends where to eat based on a natural-language request.

agentUseCases.workflow: Match intent → check availability via Reservation Intelligence → prepare a booking for approval.
Discover + compare options and present a ranked shortlist with reasons.
Use discovery as the top of a funnel into ordering or reservation chains.

human_approval_required._note: Read-only discovery; no outward-facing actions. Booking/ordering happen in chained gated APIs (Reservation Intelligence, Multi-Restaurant Ordering).

chain_to.reason: Check open tables at the top match.
Start an order from the discovered restaurant.
Validate the pick with deeper review data.

recommended_actions_priority_order.action: Call /match-restaurant-to-intent with the full intent object.
Present the top 3 by match_score with best_for reasons.
Chain to availability or ordering for the chosen restaurant.

examplePrompts: Find a romantic gluten-free Italian place near downtown Austin under $45 a head.
Compare these three restaurants on rating, price, and dietary fit.
Rank these spots for a casual family dinner within 10 minutes.
Where should two people go for date night tonight near me?
